terms.meaning: one row in a list, such as one file or one setting
a named style option, such as plain, outlined, or muted, chosen by the code using the component
a helper library that builds style options from named variants
a part that passes its settings onto the element it wraps
a limit that cuts text off after a set number of lines

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Brings in the slot helper, the style helpers, and the divider part. Nothing is shown on screen.
sections.why: Likely reason: sets up the helpers the row parts need.

sections.name: ItemGroup
sections.title: List group wrapper
sections.what: Builds the wrapper that stacks rows vertically and is marked as a list for screen readers.
sections.why: Likely reason: stacks rows together as one list.

sections.name: ItemSeparator
sections.title: Divider between rows
sections.what: Builds a horizontal line used between rows, with no outer margin. Defines the style options for the row: plain, outlined, or muted, and normal or small size.
sections.why: Likely reason: separates rows visually and sets their look and spacing.

sections.name: Item
sections.title: Row container with optional link behavior
sections.what: Builds the row itself and applies the chosen variant and size. It can pass its settings to a child element instead of a plain box, so a row can act as a link or button.
sections.why: Likely reason: the main row can be a plain box or a clickable element.
sections.watch_out: When the child element is a link or button, its own accessibility labels must still be correct.

sections.name: ItemMedia
sections.title: Image or icon area
sections.what: Builds the area for an icon or image at the start of the row, with a plain, icon, or image style.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the row a visual marker.

sections.name: ItemContent
sections.title: Text content area
sections.what: Builds the column that holds the title and description and grows to fill the row.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps text lined up and lets it take the free space.

sections.name: ItemTitle
sections.title: Title text
sections.what: Builds the bold-ish heading for a row.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives each row a clear name.

sections.name: ItemDescription
sections.title: Description text
sections.what: Builds the grey text under the title. It is cut to two lines on screen.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps rows compact by limiting how much text shows.
sections.watch_out: Text past two lines is hidden without a warning, so important details can go unseen.

sections.name: ItemActions
sections.title: Actions area
sections.what: Builds the area on the far side of the row for buttons or other controls.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps row actions together in one place.

sections.name: ItemHeader
sections.title: Header area
sections.what: Builds the top strip that spreads its content across the full row width.
sections.why: Likely reason: places a heading or status above the row content.

sections.name: ItemFooter
sections.title: Footer area and exports
sections.what: Builds the bottom strip with the same full-width layout as the header. The final list makes all parts available to other files.
sections.why: Likely reason: places extra information or actions below the row content.

summary: Builds list rows (called items) that hold a media area, text, actions, and optional header and footer areas, in several styles and sizes, plus a group wrapper and separators.
purpose: Gives lists and cards a consistent row layout, such as a file list or a settings list.
why: Likely reason: a shared row layout keeps lists consistent. The code does not state this directly.
how: It imports the separator, slot helper, and style helpers. It builds a list group and a separator. It builds the row with style options for a plain, outlined, or muted look, and a normal or small size. Then it builds parts for the image or icon area, the text area, the title, the description, the actions, and the header and footer. Everything is exported.
inputs: Children such as text, icons, images, and buttons, plus style options for variant and size, and an option to turn the row into a link or button.
outputs: Layout components for list rows. Nothing is stored.
risks: Turning a row into a link or button passes its settings to the child element, so that child must stay accessible. Long descriptions are cut to two lines on screen, so text can be hidden.
debug: If a row looks cramped or stretched, check the size option and the parts used inside it. If a description looks cut off, that is the two-line limit. If clicks do nothing, check whether asChild is set.
